children: Heavy rains continue to show up in the forecast for the next week according to NOAA, with 1 to upwards of 4 inches expected from TX to the Great Lakes, and NE to IN. Ohio and a line east of the Ohio river are expected to see lower totals.

Commitment of Traders data from CFTC showed managed money trimming back 12,405 contracts to their net long position in corn futures and options. As of September 22 their net long position was 414,437 contracts.
Export Sales data from Thursday took total corn export commitments to 18.238 MMT, a decline of 29% from a year ago. That was still 22% of the USDA projection and behind the 29% average sales pace.
